title: Banana - Green: modeled ₹402/qtl left, Kayamkulam → Chala
summary: January 2021: reported banana - Green prices at Kayamkulam and Chala imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹402 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 222 same-variety market pairs screened for banana - Green in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Chala report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam (Kerala) and Chala (Kerala) both reported banana - Green prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam reported a median ₹1,900 per quintal. Chala reported a median ₹2,727 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹727/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹727 per quintal, and Chala was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 107 km by road
scenes.caption: 107 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹23/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹453 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹310 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Chala report, the rule selects 23 of 24 modeled shipping days. 23 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹402 per quintal (₹266 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kayamkulam to Chala was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹40,200, or ₹26,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to banana - Green
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹23/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kayamkulam to Chala was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹40,200, or ₹26,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

summary: October 2021: reported banana - Green prices at Palayam and Chala imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 95% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹602 per quintal. No actual trade verified.

caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.

This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.
